20321-a-brief-account-of-the-destruction:
A Brief Account of the Destruction of the Indies reports Spain's cruelty in the Americas. Bartolomé de las Casas wrote it to expose horrors in the colonies. Good and learned men urged him to publish this summary, he says. He drew it from a far larger history of the same subject.

His aim was to display these enormities unto the whole world. Las Casas had seen conquest's violence as a priest in the Indies. His brief, burning account shook Europe and fueled Spain's Black Legend. Readers get one of the most famous protest texts of the colonial age.
